SELECT p.poem_id, p.title, pt.name AS poet_name, p.creation_year AS create_year, p.poem_form AS form, CHAR_LENGTH(p.content) AS word_count, IFNULL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.score), 1) FROM poem_rating r WHERE r.poem_id = p.poem_id), 0) AS avg_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poem_rating r WHERE r.poem_id = p.poem_id) AS rating_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poem_comment c WHERE c.poem_id = p.poem_id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poem_favorite f WHERE f.poem_id = p.poem_id) AS favorite_count FROM poem p JOIN poet pt ON pt.poet_id = p.poet_id
ORDER BY avg_score DESC, p.poem_id DESC
ORDER BY p.title ASC
ORDER BY p.poem_id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poem p JOIN poet pt ON pt.poet_id = p.poet_id

SELECT poem_id, title, content, creation_year AS create_year, poem_form AS form, word_count, appreciation, poet_id, poet_name, pen_name, birth_year, death_year, genres, avg_score, comment_count, favorite_count FROM v_poem_detail WHERE poem_id = #{poemId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poem WHERE poem_id = #{poemId} AND publication_status = 'published'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poem (title, content, creation_year, poem_form, appreciation, poet_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{createYear}, #{form}, #{appreciation}, #{poetId})
mapper.update: UPDATE poem SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, creation_year = #{createYear}, poem_form = #{form}, appreciation = #{appreciation}, poet_id = #{poetId} WHERE poem_id = #{poemId}
